# VoxelReadyResult

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Editing` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public sealed class VoxelReadyResult : IDisposable
```

What [`VoxelReady.Apply()`](Nfty.Core.Editing.VoxelReady.md#m-apply-nfty-core-formats-loadedcookbook) did: the snapped book plus enough to undo it. Owns the pre-snap images it holds; dispose it when the undo is no longer wanted.
